title: skills(objectstack-automation): a clashing bare function name is not "refused at install"; the bind fails and the whole owner group stays unbound
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (should-fix F1 of the at-tier retro review of merged PR #33396, card #32429's sibling; record on that PR).

**What is wrong.** The sentence PR #33396 added to `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` says a second package's clashing bare function name is "refused at install". On `main` `8e63ed87` no install door judges a function: `function` is not a registry type, and the only door is the hook binder's bind (`claimBareNameFunctions`). `bindAppArtifactHandlers` catches that throw per owner group and logs "Failed to bind declarative hooks" at `error`. The second package installs; every function and hook of that owner group stays unbound, including the ones that do not clash. The author sees no refusal: their `script` node fails as unregistered or, if the package depends on the first holder, runs the other package's function.

**What lands.** Reword the sentence to what happens (the bind fails at boot or install with an error log, the owner group's functions and hooks stay unbound), keep the remedy (rename, or another namespace). The file is at its token ceiling (6861 of 6861), so the fix pays in place. Fold in F3 (the parenthesis merges a new holder after boot with a pair held at boot).

Related, code side, read not reviewed: `packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts` L214-216 still says the function bind refusal "stays until the trailing backstop child (ADR-0150 D9) narrows it", which has narrowed; `bareNameColdBootWarning` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` uses the same loose "refused at install" for a function. Fix those comments/texts in the same PR only if the owning lane agrees; otherwise note them.

`@objectstack/skills` patch. `Clause-②: no`.
